acceptance: Add an executable MySQL (or compatible) check, or document that retirement is manual only.
Baseline schema and guard tests reflect the chosen policy.
description: The runtime baseline case mysql-percentile-decorator only parses transpiled SQL; MySQL has no native PERCENTILE_CONT and nothing is executed against MySQL. After an oracle finding, a passing MySQL case can no longer retire the workaround (the guard requires decision 'retain'), so the CASE/NULL proxy can never be retired automatically.
